reviews.text: Takes Too Long To Access. I truly enjoy the app for its purpose as a “quick” Bible access, as well as the daily reminders and quiz functions. However, I truly despise how long it takes to actually access the actual point of the app. First, it slowly asks each and every time you launch the app, “how do you feel?” and depending on the emotion you select, shows a related Bible verse (which is an aspect I do like, if it weren’t so slow). Then, whether you select an emotion or choose to skip (when it finally gives you the option), it immediately always goes to an unskippable ad that is either long or is required to be interactive for so long (and after what feels like forever), finally gives you the option to close the ad. I understand that forcing people to watch ads “helps keep the app free,” but they shouldn’t be so long or interactive, and should be able to be skipped. I usually just end up closing said app and opening safari to google the passages I’m wanting to read, as it’s much faster.
